note: Made by the steps in TV_PICTURES.md: the chapter is split into sections that each carry one deep meaning ("sections"), 10 picture ideas are written for each, the top two for each picture are made and the better is chosen by eye (2026-11-22). Wide pictures only (1920x1088); the "tall" names are kept for the day tall pictures are switched back on. Each scene starts at the first word of its verse, or at its "from" words inside the verse. The important part of every picture sits in the upper two thirds, clear of the words. God is not pictured, and Jesus, John, the disciples and the questioners are not portrayed: the text's own images (light, the tent, the lamb, the dove, the fig tree, the open sky) are moved into today, and its human moments are shown through ordinary people of today.
method: Second method, asked for by Obay on 2026-11-21 after the sentence-by-sentence pictures did not connect: (1) split the chapter into sections that each carry one deep meaning, written as one plain sentence; (2) write 10 different picture ideas for each section; (3) judge them: which shows the deep meaning most truly, then which a watcher understands at once while hearing the words, then which is most engaging; (4) make the top two for each picture slot as real pictures ("candidates") and choose by eye. A section has one or two pictures (three for the longer ones).

sections.meaning: The Word was with God from the beginning, everything that exists came to be through him, and the life in him is a light that the darkness has not overcome.
ideas: A vast untouched landscape in fresh morning light, river, forest, hills and sea, flocks of birds rising: everything newly made
A single green shoot unfolding out of dark bare soil
At night in a storm, huge waves break on the rocks under a lighthouse whose beam shines steady across the black sea
In a pitch-dark cave a single shaft of sunlight falls from an opening high above and the dark cannot dim it
A struck match flares in a pitch-black cellar
A lone lit window glows in a vast dark snowy valley
A miner's lamp shining down a long black tunnel
A sprout pushing up through a crack in dark asphalt toward the light
The Milky Way over a dark sea, the whole universe spread out
Sunlight breaking through a hole in thunderclouds onto a dark sea

sections.meaning: John was sent only to point people to the light so that they might believe; he was not the light himself.
ideas: On a dark shore a man in shadow stretches out his arm and points to a lighthouse beam, and the people beside him turn to look
On a dark street a man points lost travellers to a brightly lit open doorway at the end of the road
A night watchman on a wall points down the valley to the lights of the coming rescue
A boy on a dark hill points his family to the first glow on the horizon
The moon, bright only with light that is not its own, over a dark landscape
A station worker in a power cut, holding no light himself, waves the crowd toward the lit exit
A signpost at a dark crossroads pointing toward a lit town
A best man stepping aside so the groom can be seen
A guide in the dark pointing climbers toward a lit hut
A mirror throwing a beam of sunlight into a dark room, the sun itself out of frame

sections.meaning: The true light came into the world he made and his own people shut him out, but all who take him in are made God's own children, born not by blood or human will but from God.
ideas: Bright morning sunlight pours onto a house, and from inside a hand pulls the shutters closed against it
A grown son home after years stands with his suitcase in the rain while the door of his family's house closes on him
A painter stands unnoticed in a crowded gallery of his own paintings
A builder stands outside the house he built and the owners draw the curtains
A newly adopted girl with her small suitcase is walked up the path to her new home holding her new parents' hands
A big brother puts his arm round his newly arrived adopted little brother and shows him the room they will share
A family plants a tree in the garden on the day a new child joins them
A child's height mark is added on the door frame beside the other children's marks
A newborn's hand closing round a father's finger
A family round the dinner table with one new chair and a new child in it

sections.meaning: The Word became flesh and lived among us, full of grace and truth; from his fullness we all receive grace upon grace, and he makes the unseen God known.
ideas: In a camp of plain grey tents at dusk one more small tent has been pitched among them and glows warm from within, the families standing in its light
In a crowded camp a man pitches his own small tent between the families' tents while the children help hold the poles
A man moves his few boxes into a run-down block while the neighbours watch from their doorways
A doctor who moved into a poor village sits on a doorstep among the families
Many hands of all ages hold out cups under a fountain that pours out water in abundance, every cup running over
A stair of brimming pools down a mountainside, each overflowing into the next
Wave upon wave rolling onto a bright beach
A cook keeps ladling from a huge pot into bowl after bowl and the pot is still full
A son who looks just like his father tells others what his father is like
A rain shower over a parched field, every furrow filling

sections.meaning: Asked who he is, John claims nothing for himself: he is only a voice calling people to clear the way for one far greater, who already stands among them unknown.
ideas: Reporters and officials push microphones at a plain man in work clothes by a river; he shakes his head and holds up his open hand: not me
A crowd tries to lift a modest man onto their shoulders and he refuses, pointing away from himself
Across a wide empty desert a road crew cuts a new road dead straight to the horizon, levelling hills and filling hollows
A lone man stands on a rock in a vast desert canyon and shouts with his hands cupped round his mouth
A man stands waist-deep in a wide river and lifts another up out of the water while people watch from the bank
A long line of people wait on a riverbank to come down into the water, where a man holds out his hand to the next one
A man kneels at the riverbank and stops short of touching a pair of worn sandals
Workers sweep and clear a long road before an arrival
A mountain path being cleared of fallen rocks
A man with a megaphone on an empty plain

sections.meaning: John points to Jesus as the lamb who takes away the sin of the world, and testifies that he saw the spirit come down and stay on him: this is the Son of God.
ideas: A single young white lamb walks along a dirt path straight toward the viewer in clear morning light
A white lamb stands alone on a bare hilltop against a vast bright sky, looking at the viewer
A lamb lying calm in a field while a storm passes away behind it
A white dove glides down out of a bright opening in the clouds above a calm river
A white dove comes down to land on the branch of a riverside tree and settles there
A man on a riverbank points across the water and says look
A dark stain lifting out of white cloth in clear water
A slate wiped clean
Sunlight breaking through clouds onto a river
A dove resting on a sunlit rail by the water

sections.meaning: Those who hear him follow, come and see for themselves and stay, and the first thing they do is bring the ones they love.
ideas: At the end of the afternoon two young men walk up a path toward a plain house whose door stands wide open, warm light pouring out
On a riverbank an old teacher turns his two young students away from himself and points them up the road
Two young men walking eagerly up a country road
A table set for guests by a lit open door at evening
On a fishing quay a young man, breathless and beaming, grabs his brother's arm as he mends nets and pulls him to come
A young man hurries his brother by the hand along a harbour street, both laughing
A young man bursts into his brother's workshop with news
A brother phoning his brother at night with great news
Two brothers running up from the harbour side by side
A rough stone in a stonemason's hand being given its first shape

sections.meaning: A doubter is invited to come and see, finds that he was already fully known before anyone called him, and is promised greater things: heaven opened.
ideas: On a porch a man leans back with arms folded and an eyebrow raised in doubt while his friend leans in, eager, beckoning him to come
A man on a low wall with arms crossed looks doubtfully at his friend, who points down the road to a small dusty village
A man sits alone in the deep shade of a large fig tree in a quiet field, deep in thought, seen from a distance
Under the broad leaves of an old fig tree a man sits alone with his eyes closed, figs hanging above him
A man looks up startled as a stranger calls him by name
Over a wide plain the clouds have broken open and a great stair of light pours down from the opening to the earth
A man on a hill looks up in wonder at a sky that has opened above him, light streaming down
Birds rising and coming down along a shaft of light
A ladder leaning up into a bright sky
A door opening onto a blaze of light

scenes.principle: In the beginning was the Word, and all things came to be through him.
scenes.shows: A vast untouched landscape in fresh morning light: a river winding through forest and hills to the sea, mountains beyond, birds rising, everything newly made.
scenes.prompt: A vast untouched landscape in fresh, clear morning light: a wide river winds through deep green forests and rolling hills down to a shining sea, high mountains beyond, flocks of birds rising over the water. Everything looks newly made and full of life. The sun itself is out of frame; the light is even and bright.

scenes.principle: In him was life, and the life is a light that shines in the darkness, and the darkness did not overcome it.
scenes.shows: At night in a storm, huge waves burst against the rocks under a lighthouse whose beam shines out steady across the black sea.
scenes.prompt: At night in a raging storm, huge dark waves crash and burst white against the rocks at the foot of a tall lighthouse, and its bright beam shines out steady and strong across the black sea. Rain streaks the air, the sky is black, and the light keeps shining.

scenes.principle: John was not the light; he came to point people to the light so that all might believe.
scenes.shows: On a dark shore a man in shadow, carrying no light of his own, points to the lighthouse beam, and the people beside him turn to look.
scenes.prompt: On a dark rocky shore at night, a man in a plain jacket stands in shadow with his arm stretched out, pointing toward a lighthouse beam that shines out across the sea. A small group of people beside him turn to look where he points. He carries no light himself; the light comes only from the lighthouse.

scenes.principle: He came to what was his own, and his own did not take him in.
scenes.shows: A grown son with a suitcase stands in the rain before the shut front door of his family's house while, through the window, they eat dinner without looking up.
scenes.prompt: In the evening rain, a grown son with a small suitcase stands alone on the doorstep of his family's house, home after many years, facing a front door that is firmly shut. Through the big lit window beside the door the family sits at dinner, warm and bright, and nobody looks up at him.

scenes.principle: All who receive him are given the right to become God's children, born not from blood but from God.
scenes.shows: A big brother puts his arm round his newly arrived adopted little brother, who still holds his bag, and shows him the room they will share.
scenes.prompt: A big brother of about ten puts his arm round the shoulders of his newly adopted little brother, who looks different from him and has just arrived holding a small suitcase, and shows him the bright bedroom they will share, with two beds side by side. Both boys are smiling.

scenes.principle: The Word became flesh and pitched his tent among us, and we gazed at his glory.
scenes.shows: At dusk in a camp of plain grey tents, one more small tent pitched among them glows warm from within, and the families stand round it in its light.
scenes.prompt: At dusk in a large camp of plain grey tents where poor families live, one more small tent has been pitched right in the middle among theirs, and it glows warm and golden from within. The families have come out of their dark tents and stand round it in its light.

scenes.principle: From his fullness we all received, grace upon grace.
scenes.shows: Many hands of all ages hold out cups under an overflowing village fountain, every cup running over.
scenes.prompt: In a sunny village square a stone fountain pours out clear water in abundance, and many hands of all ages, young and old, hold out cups under it. Every cup is full and running over, and the water keeps pouring.

scenes.principle: Questioned about who he is, John claims nothing for himself: I am not the Christ.
scenes.shows: Reporters and officials push microphones at a plain man in work clothes by a river; he shakes his head and holds up his open hand: not me.
scenes.prompt: By a river in daylight, a crowd of men in suits and reporters with microphones and cameras press round a plain bearded man in rough work clothes, questioning him. He shakes his head and holds up his open hand toward them: not me.

scenes.principle: I am a voice of one shouting in the wilderness: make straight the way of the Lord.
scenes.shows: A lone man stands on a rock in a vast desert canyon, shouting with his hands cupped round his mouth.
scenes.prompt: In a vast, empty desert canyon of red rock, a lone man in plain clothes stands on a boulder and shouts with his hands cupped round his mouth, calling out across all that emptiness. He is small against the huge silent landscape.

scenes.principle: I baptize in water, but one far greater already stands among you.
scenes.shows: A man standing waist-deep in a wide river lifts another up out of the water while people watch from the bank.
scenes.prompt: A man in plain everyday clothes stands waist-deep in a wide brown river and lifts another man up out of the water after immersing him, water streaming off him. On the green bank behind them a crowd of ordinary people of today watches and waits. Daylight.

scenes.principle: Look, the lamb of God who takes away the sin of the world.
scenes.shows: A young white lamb walks along a hillside path toward the viewer in clear morning light.
scenes.prompt: A young white lamb walks along a dirt path across a green hillside toward the camera, calm and gentle, in clear morning light. It is the only animal in sight.

scenes.principle: The spirit came down as a dove from heaven and remained on him: this is the Son of God.
scenes.shows: A white dove glides down out of a bright opening in the clouds above a calm river.
scenes.prompt: A white dove glides down out of a bright opening in the clouds above a calm river, its wings spread wide, coming down to land. Soft light streams down through the opening around it.

scenes.principle: Again John points to him: Look, the lamb of God.
scenes.shows: A young white lamb stands alone on a grassy hilltop under a wide bright sky, facing the viewer.
scenes.prompt: A young white lamb stands alone on a grassy hilltop under a wide bright sky, facing the camera, still and gentle.

scenes.principle: The two follow him; he says, Come and you will see, and they stay with him.
scenes.shows: Late in the afternoon two young men, seen from behind, walk up a path into a house whose door stands open, warm light pouring out.
scenes.prompt: Late in the afternoon, two young men in plain clothes, seen from behind, walk up a path toward a plain house whose door stands wide open, warm light pouring out of the doorway to meet them. They are just about to go in.

scenes.principle: The first thing Andrew does is find his own brother and bring him.
scenes.shows: On a fishing quay a young man, breathless and beaming, grabs his brother's arm as he mends nets and pulls him to come.
scenes.prompt: On a fishing quay a young man, out of breath and beaming, grabs his older brother's arm as he sits mending nets beside their boat and pulls him to come, pointing excitedly up the road. Daylight, boats in the harbour.

scenes.principle: Can anything good come from Nazareth? Come and see.
scenes.shows: On a porch a man sits with arms folded and an eyebrow raised in doubt while his friend leans in, eager, urging him to come.
scenes.prompt: On the porch of a small house, a man leans back in his chair with his arms folded and one eyebrow raised in doubt, while his friend leans toward him, eager, beckoning him to get up and come and see. Daylight.

scenes.principle: Before anyone called you, while you were under the fig tree, I saw you.
scenes.shows: A man sits alone in the shade of an old fig tree with his eyes closed, figs hanging on the branches above him.
scenes.prompt: Seen through the large lobed leaves of an old fig tree, a man in plain clothes sits alone in its shade with his eyes closed, quiet and thoughtful, a few green figs hanging on the branches above him. Dappled daylight.

scenes.shows: A man on a grassy hill looks up at a sky that has opened wide above him, light streaming down.
scenes.prompt: A man stands on a grassy hill and looks up in wonder at the sky, which has opened wide above him, the clouds rolled back on both sides and brilliant light streaming down onto him.

chosen_from: 36 trial pictures made 2026-11-22 (two per picture slot, plus a shut-door remake); the chosen ones were copied from their trial names.
